queries.name: snapshot_tables
queries.sql:
SELECT
    s.name AS schema_name,
    t.name AS table_name,
    t.object_id
FROM sys.tables AS t
JOIN sys.schemas AS s
    ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id
WHERE 
s.name = 'dbo'
AND t.name IN (
    'Comercial_RecetasSnapshot',
    'Comercial_RecetasSnapshotDetalle'
)

ORDER BY t.name

queries.name: snapshot_columns
queries.sql:
SELECT
    t.name AS table_name,
    c.column_id,
    c.name AS column_name,
    ty.name AS data_type,
    c.max_length,
    c.precision,
    c.scale,
    c.is_nullable,
    c.is_identity,
    c.is_computed
FROM sys.tables AS t
JOIN sys.schemas AS s
    ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id
JOIN sys.columns AS c
    ON c.object_id = t.object_id
JOIN sys.types AS ty
    ON ty.user_type_id = c.user_type_id
WHERE 
s.name = 'dbo'
AND t.name IN (
    'Comercial_RecetasSnapshot',
    'Comercial_RecetasSnapshotDetalle'
)

ORDER BY t.name, c.column_id

queries.name: snapshot_indexes
queries.sql:
SELECT
    t.name AS table_name,
    i.name AS index_name,
    i.type_desc,
    i.is_unique,
    i.is_primary_key,
    i.is_unique_constraint,
    i.has_filter,
    i.filter_definition,
    ic.key_ordinal,
    ic.is_included_column,
    c.name AS column_name
FROM sys.tables AS t
JOIN sys.schemas AS s
    ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id
JOIN sys.indexes AS i
    ON i.object_id = t.object_id
LEFT JOIN sys.index_columns AS ic
    ON ic.object_id = i.object_id
    AND ic.index_id = i.index_id
LEFT JOIN sys.columns AS c
    ON c.object_id = ic.object_id
    AND c.column_id = ic.column_id
WHERE 
s.name = 'dbo'
AND t.name IN (
    'Comercial_RecetasSnapshot',
    'Comercial_RecetasSnapshotDetalle'
)

ORDER BY t.name, i.index_id, ic.key_ordinal, ic.index_column_id

queries.name: snapshot_constraints
queries.sql:
SELECT
    t.name AS table_name,
    kc.name AS constraint_name,
    kc.type_desc,
    kc.unique_index_id
FROM sys.tables AS t
JOIN sys.schemas AS s
    ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id
JOIN sys.key_constraints AS kc
    ON kc.parent_object_id = t.object_id
WHERE 
s.name = 'dbo'
AND t.name IN (
    'Comercial_RecetasSnapshot',
    'Comercial_RecetasSnapshotDetalle'
)

ORDER BY t.name, kc.name

queries.name: snapshot_foreign_keys
queries.sql:
SELECT
    OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS source_table,
    fk.name AS foreign_key_name,
    pc.name AS source_column,
    OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) AS referenced_table,
    rc.name AS referenced_column,
    fk.is_disabled,
    fk.is_not_trusted
FROM sys.foreign_keys AS fk
JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns AS fkc
    ON fkc.constraint_object_id = fk.object_id
JOIN sys.columns AS pc
    ON pc.object_id = fkc.parent_object_id
    AND pc.column_id = fkc.parent_column_id
JOIN sys.columns AS rc
    ON rc.object_id = fkc.referenced_object_id
    AND rc.column_id = fkc.referenced_column_id
WHERE
    fk.parent_object_id IN (
        OBJECT_ID('dbo.Comercial_RecetasSnapshot'),
        OBJECT_ID('dbo.Comercial_RecetasSnapshotDetalle')
    )
    OR fk.referenced_object_id IN (
        OBJECT_ID('dbo.Comercial_RecetasSnapshot'),
        OBJECT_ID('dbo.Comercial_RecetasSnapshotDetalle')
    )
ORDER BY source_table, foreign_key_name, fkc.constraint_column_id

queries.name: snapshot_check_constraints
queries.sql:
SELECT
    t.name AS table_name,
    cc.name AS constraint_name,
    cc.definition,
    cc.is_disabled,
    cc.is_not_trusted
FROM sys.tables AS t
JOIN sys.schemas AS s
    ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id
JOIN sys.check_constraints AS cc
    ON cc.parent_object_id = t.object_id
WHERE 
s.name = 'dbo'
AND t.name IN (
    'Comercial_RecetasSnapshot',
    'Comercial_RecetasSnapshotDetalle'
)

ORDER BY t.name, cc.name

objective: Certificar exclusivamente mediante metadatos SQL Server las estructuras físicas existentes de dbo.Comercial_RecetasSnapshot y dbo.Comercial_RecetasSnapshotDetalle. Identificar columnas, tipos, claves, índices, restricciones y relaciones para evaluar idempotencia, concurrencia, inmutabilidad y viabilidad de snapshots mensuales. No modificar datos, código, Scheduler ni Producción.
